title: Knowledge Graph Engineer
description: Meridian National Bank is hiring a Knowledge Graph Engineer to build our enterprise data fabric using RDF and SPARQL.
qualifications: 3+ years building production data pipelines; experience with graph data modeling preferred.
responsibilities: Design and operate the bank's knowledge graph platform; write and optimize SPARQL queries against our RDF triple store.

title: Ontologist - Drug Discovery Data
description: Helion Pharmaceuticals seeks an Ontologist to formalize drug discovery knowledge using OWL and SPARQL over our research data lake.
qualifications: Background in biomedical ontologies; familiarity with description logics.
responsibilities: Author and maintain OWL ontologies; support scientists querying the data lake with SPARQL.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: We're building our product knowledge graph using RDF and SPARQL to power search and recommendations across our online storefront.
qualifications: Strong SQL and Python; comfort with graph data models is a plus.
responsibilities: Extend ETL pipelines that feed the product knowledge graph; collaborate with search on SPARQL query performance.

title: Metadata Specialist
description: The Department of Civic Records is hiring a Metadata Specialist to lead taxonomy management for our public records catalog.
qualifications: Experience with controlled vocabularies and records management standards.
responsibilities: Own metadata standards for civic datasets; run taxonomy management workshops with records staff.

title: Research Data Steward
description: Ashcombe University Library seeks a Research Data Steward with experience using SKOS and linked data to describe our institutional repository.
qualifications: Familiarity with library metadata standards and controlled vocabularies.
responsibilities: Publish repository metadata as linked data; maintain SKOS vocabularies for subject classification.

title: Semantic Web Architect
description: Northbridge Consulting Partners is looking for a Semantic Web Architect to lead client engagements spanning OWL modeling and SHACL validation.
qualifications: Client-facing consulting experience; deep knowledge of W3C semantic web standards.
responsibilities: Design OWL ontologies for clients; define SHACL shapes to validate delivered RDF datasets.

title: Quality Assurance Technician
description: Ferrostal Industrial Works needs a Quality Assurance Technician to inspect steel components against tolerance specifications on the shop floor.
qualifications: Experience with calipers, gauges, and standard QA inspection procedures.
responsibilities: Perform incoming and in-process inspections; log nonconformances and support root-cause analysis.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description: Vantage Freight Logistics is hiring a Supply Chain Analyst to build graph analytics dashboards tracking shipment routes and delays.
qualifications: Strong Excel and BI tooling skills; SQL a plus.
responsibilities: Build and maintain routing dashboards; present graph analytics summaries to operations leadership weekly.

title: Taxonomy Librarian
description: Meridian Broadcasting Archive seeks a Taxonomy Librarian responsible for maintaining our editorial content taxonomy and tagging guidelines.
qualifications: MLIS or equivalent library science background.
responsibilities: Curate the editorial content taxonomy; train editorial staff on consistent tagging practices.

title: Data & Insights Coordinator
description: The role focuses on owl population monitoring near wetland habitats and compiling field survey data for our annual report.
qualifications: Fieldwork experience and comfort with spreadsheets; wildlife biology background preferred.
responsibilities: Coordinate volunteer owl survey teams; compile and summarize seasonal population counts.

title: Knowledge Graph Architect
description: Solstice Mutual Insurance is hiring a Knowledge Graph Architect to design the RDFS and SHACL foundations of our claims data model.
qualifications: Experience architecting large-scale RDF systems; strong stakeholder communication skills.
responsibilities: Define RDFS class hierarchies for claims entities; author SHACL shapes enforcing data quality.

title: Entity Resolution Specialist
description: Arcstream Telecom is hiring an Entity Resolution Specialist to lead semantic integration of customer records across billing systems.
qualifications: Experience with record matching and deduplication techniques.
responsibilities: Design entity resolution rules for customer identity; drive semantic integration between billing and CRM systems.

title: Energy Grid Analyst
description: Helios Grid Energy is hiring an Energy Grid Analyst. No SPARQL experience is required for this role; we primarily use SQL for reporting.
qualifications: Strong SQL skills; experience with utility load forecasting a plus.
responsibilities: Build SQL reports on grid load and outage trends; support the analytics team with ad hoc queries.

title: Knowledge Graph Intern
description: Fieldsense Agritech is hiring a Knowledge Graph Intern to help model crop and soil sensor data as RDF for our research team.
qualifications: Currently pursuing a degree in computer science or a related field.
responsibilities: Assist in modeling sensor readings as RDF triples; support small internal knowledge graph demos.

title: Contracts Administrator
description: Whitfield & Moore LLP is hiring a Contracts Administrator to manage vendor agreements and renewal timelines for the firm.
qualifications: Paralegal certificate or equivalent contracts administration experience.
responsibilities: Track contract renewal deadlines; maintain the firm's vendor agreement filing system.

title: Guest Experience Manager
description: GraphPoint Hospitality Group is hiring a Guest Experience Manager to oversee front-desk operations and guest satisfaction programs.
qualifications: 3+ years of hotel front-desk or guest services management experience.
responsibilities: Manage front-desk staff scheduling; resolve guest escalations and oversee loyalty program enrollment.

title: GIS & Data Modeler
description: Cornerstone Realty Analytics is hiring you to act as our Semantic Data Modeler, connecting property records through a graph database layer.
qualifications: Experience with GIS data and relational or graph data modeling.
responsibilities: Design the semantic layer linking property, parcel, and ownership records; evaluate graph database options for the platform.

title: LinkML Schema Developer
description: Transit Systems Authority is hiring a LinkML Schema Developer to define linked-data schemas for our regional transit data platform.
qualifications: Experience with schema modeling tools and linked-data serializations.
responsibilities: Author and maintain LinkML schemas for transit datasets; generate RDF and JSON Schema outputs from those schemas.

title: Taxonomist
description: Bramwell Academic Publishing is hiring a Taxonomist to lead taxonomy management initiatives across our editorial catalog.
qualifications: Experience governing controlled vocabularies in a publishing or content environment.
responsibilities: Own taxonomy management processes including term creation, deprecation, and mapping across catalog systems.

title: GraphRAG Engineer
description: Solace AI Labs is hiring a GraphRAG Engineer to build retrieval pipelines using GraphRAG techniques backed by a Neo4j graph store.
qualifications: Experience with LLM retrieval pipelines and graph-backed retrieval techniques.
responsibilities: Build and evaluate GraphRAG retrieval pipelines; operate the team's Neo4j deployment.
